title: Popular Markets in Benue State (Nigeria Galleria)

claims.north-bank: The page says North Bank Market in Makurdi is a big market selling fresh farm produce and food items, clothes and shoes, home wares, building materials and cosmetics.
claims.wurukum: The page says Wurukum market in Makurdi is a large daily market where farmers bring raw produce from their farms to sell at cheap rates.
